title: SafeTrip travel insurance
summary: Overview of UnitedHealthcare Global SafeTrip travel insurance plans, add-ons, benefits and contact information.

atoms.title: SafeTrip travel insurance overview
atoms.question: What is UnitedHealthcare Global SafeTrip travel insurance?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare Global SafeTrip supports travelers with trip protection that helps manage unexpected interruptions, delays, cancellations and accidents, whether traveling internationally or within the United States. It can be paired with travel medical insurance, which supports health needs when outside the country.
questions: Can I pair trip protection with travel medical insurance?

atoms.title: SafeTrip's three travel insurance plan types
atoms.question: What SafeTrip travel plans are available?
atoms.text: SafeTrip offers three plan types. International Travel Medical Plus combines international medical coverage and travel protection, including trip cancellation, interruption, delay and baggage coverage, plus medical and security assistance. International Travel Medical is emergency medical insurance for trips outside the United States, with up to $1 million for the medical expense limit and coverage for medical evacuation and medical assistance. Travel Protection is available for U.S. domestic travel only, with trip cancellation, interruption, delay and baggage coverage and full AD&D coverage.

atoms.title: Extreme sports, equipment and rental car add-ons
atoms.question: What add-on coverage can I add to SafeTrip travel insurance?
atoms.text: SafeTrip travelers can add insurance for extreme sports coverage, sporting equipment delay or loss, and rental car damage. UnitedHealthcare describes this as special coverage for a special trip, and links to a dedicated page that explains the travel insurance add-ons.
questions: Can I add rental car coverage to travel insurance?

atoms.title: What travel insurance is
atoms.question: What is travel insurance?
atoms.text: Travel insurance is coverage that eases worry when something goes wrong away from home, whether a person is traveling for fun, work, volunteering or another reason. UnitedHealthcare notes there is plenty that can go wrong away from home, and travel insurance lets travelers focus on the important things knowing they are covered.
questions: Why do I need travel insurance?

atoms.title: Four benefits of SafeTrip travel insurance
atoms.question: What benefits does SafeTrip travel insurance provide?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare lists four benefits. Protect your investment: reimbursement for expenses related to trip delays, cancellations and baggage loss. Get the care you deserve: staff can help find the right doctor easily and quickly. Stay covered abroad: international travel medical coverage can reimburse small medical costs or cover larger medical expenses. Enjoy 24/7 access to help: travelers can call the in-house Emergency Response Center (ERC) anytime.
questions: What does SafeTrip's Emergency Response Center do?

atoms.title: SafeTrip by the numbers
atoms.question: How large is SafeTrip's support and provider network?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare describes SafeTrip as offering around-the-clock support and a global provider network. Its page lists four figures for SafeTrip: 24/7 support, 150+ countries, 2.4 million+ providers and 45+ years of experience.

atoms.title: SafeTrip resources and sales contact
atoms.question: How do I contact SafeTrip about a plan or group travel?
atoms.text: People with questions, who need help choosing a plan or who are covering a large group can contact the SafeTrip information and sales team toll free at 1-800-732-5309, internationally at 1-410-453-6380, or by email at safetrip_info@uhcglobal.com. The page also links to plan comparison, trip types, claims filing and a partner page.

atoms.title: When to choose domestic versus international SafeTrip plans
atoms.question: Which SafeTrip plan type fits domestic or international trips?
atoms.text: Travel Protection plans are available for U.S. domestic travel only, while International Travel Medical and International Travel Medical Plus plans are meant for trips outside the United States. SafeTrip also directs readers to a plan comparison page and a trip types page to help decide which plan fits a journey.
